00047 class BufferChannelInternal : public SmartPointer
00048 {
00049 public:
00050   BufferChannelInternal(const unsigned int size, bool zeroData = false) throw();
00051   BufferChannelInternal(const unsigned int size, const unsigned int sourceDataSize, float* sourceData, const bool copyTheData) throw();
00052   BufferChannelInternal(const unsigned int size, const double start, const double end) throw();
00053   ~BufferChannelInternal() throw();
00054   
00055   inline float getSampleUnchecked(const int index) const throw() { return data[index]; }
00056   inline float getSampleUnchecked(const double index) const throw() { return getSampleUnchecked((float)index); }
00057   inline float getSampleUnchecked(const float index) const throw() 
00058   { 
00059     const int iIndex0 = (int)index;
00060     unsigned int iIndex1 = iIndex0+1;
00061     if(iIndex1 >= size_)
00062       iIndex1 = 0;
00063     const float frac1 = (float)index - (float)iIndex0;
00064     const float frac0 = 1.f - frac1;
00065     
00066     return data[iIndex0] * frac0 + data[iIndex1] * frac1; // need to optimise this at some point    
00067   }

00478   template<class NumericalType>
00479   inline NumericalArray2D<NumericalType> toArray() const throw()
00480   {
00481     NumericalArray2D<NumericalType> array2d;
00482     
00483     if(channels != 0)
00484     {
00485       for(int i = 0; i < numChannels_; i++)
00486       {
00487         NumericalArray<float> array = NumericalArray<float>::withArray(size_, channels[i]->data, false);
00488         array2d << NumericalArray<NumericalType>(array);
00489       }
00490     }
00491     
00492     return array2d;
00493   }
00494   
00496   template<class NumericalType>
00497   inline operator NumericalArray<NumericalType> () const throw()
00498   {
00499     return toArray<NumericalType>(0);
00500   }
00501   
00503   template<class NumericalType>
00504   inline NumericalArray<NumericalType> toArray(const int channel) const throw()
00505   {
00506     NumericalArray<NumericalType> array;
00507     
00508     if(channels != 0)
00509     {
00510       int channelToUse = channel;
00511       while(channelToUse < 0)
00512         channelToUse += numChannels_;
00513       
00514       NumericalArray<float> floatArray = NumericalArray<float>::withArray(size_, 
00515                                         channels[channel % numChannels_]->data, 
00516                                         false);
00517       array = floatArray;
00518     }
00519     
00520     return array;
00521   }

00681   Buffer operator[] (IntArray const& indices) const throw()
00682   {
00683     Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(indices.size(), numChannels_, false));
00684     
00685     const int numIndices = indices.size();
00686     for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
00687     {
00688       for(int i = 0; i < numIndices; i++)
00689       {
00690         const int index = indices.atUnchecked(i);
00691         newBuffer.setSample(channel, i, getSample(channel, index));
00692       }
00693     }
00694     
00695     return newBuffer;
00696   }

00755   inline void setCircularHead(const unsigned int blockID, const int channel, const int position) throw() 
00756   { 
00757     ugen_assert((channel >= 0) && (channel < numChannels_)); 
00758     BufferChannelInternal* internal = channels[channel];
00759     internal->previousCircularHead = internal->circularHead;
00760     internal->circularHead = position; 
00761     internal->currentWriteBlockID = blockID;
00762   }
00763   
00764   inline int getCircularHead(const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) const throw() 
00765   { 
00766     ugen_assert(channel >= 0); 
00767     BufferChannelInternal* internal = channels[channel % numChannels_];
00768     if(blockID == internal->currentWriteBlockID)
00769     {
00770       return internal->previousCircularHead;
00771     }
00772     else
00773     {
00774       return internal->circularHead;
00775     }
00776   }

00935   Buffer unary() const throw()

00966   BinaryOpMethodsDeclare(Buffer);
00967   
00969   template<BinaryOpFunction op>
00970   Buffer binary(Buffer rightOperand) throw()
00971   {
00972     const int newNumChannels = numChannels_ > rightOperand.numChannels_ ? numChannels_ : rightOperand.numChannels_; 
00973     const int maxSize = size_ > rightOperand.size_ ? size_ : rightOperand.size_;                  
00974     const int minSize = size_ < rightOperand.size_ ? size_ : rightOperand.size_;                  
00975     const int diffSize = maxSize-minSize;                                     
00976     
00977     Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(maxSize, newNumChannels, false));                         
00978     
00979     for(int channelIndex = 0; channelIndex < newNumChannels; channelIndex++)                    
00980     {                                                       
00981       int numSamples;                                               
00982       float* leftSamples = channels[channelIndex % numChannels_]->data;                     
00983       float* rightSamples = rightOperand.channels[channelIndex % rightOperand.numChannels_]->data;        
00984       float* outputSamples = newBuffer.channels[channelIndex]->data;                        
00985       
00986       if(size_ == 1 && numChannels_ == 1) {                                   
00987         numSamples = maxSize;                                         
00988         
00989         while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                        
00990           *outputSamples++ = op(*leftSamples, *rightSamples++);           
00991         }                                                   
00992       } else if(rightOperand.size_ == 1 && rightOperand.numChannels_ == 1) {                  
00993         numSamples = maxSize;                                         
00994         
00995         while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                        
00996           *outputSamples++ = op(*leftSamples++, *rightSamples);           
00997         }                                                   
00998       } else {                                                  
00999         numSamples = minSize;                                         
01000         while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                        
01001           *outputSamples++ = op(*leftSamples++, *rightSamples++);           
01002         }                                                   
01003         
01004         numSamples = diffSize;                                          
01005         if(size_ > rightOperand.size_) {                                    
01006           while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                      
01007             *outputSamples++ = op(*leftSamples++, 0.f);               
01008           }                                                 
01009         }                                                   
01010         else if(rightOperand.size_ > size_) {                                 
01011           while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                      
01012             *outputSamples++ = op(0.f, *rightSamples++);                
01013           }                                                 
01014         }                                                   
01015       }                                                     
01016     }                                                       
01017     
01018     return newBuffer;                                               
01019   }
